## What changes

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make test` on Apple Silicon macOS, or state clearly why it was not run.
- [ ] Added or updated a regression case for an observable behavior change.

For performance work, include the before/after revisions, compiler settings, hardware, exact command, output-parity result and raw samples. Distinguish a measured gain from timing noise. Preserve the pinned upstream contract unless a separate behavior change is explicitly proposed.
